Chapter 709 - 709 Another Challenge; Revenge!

Chapter 709 - 709 Another Challenge; Revenge!

709 Another Challenge; Revenge!

Time flowed like water. In the blink of an eye, seven years had passed.

In the past seven years, the system had rewarded Lin Fan with a total of five Immortal Crystals, two pieces of Emperor-level equipment, three Transcendence Golden Bodies, Top-Notch Wood Law Talent, and King-Level Skill Upgrade Gems.

On top of that, Lin Fan was cultivating even harder than before, causing his cultivation state to break through to level-three Universe. He was heading toward level-four Universe.

That was because Lin Fan knew that Earth had been exposed to the universe.

There could be danger at any time.

Since that was the case, he had to first make himself stronger.

Only in this way could he better protect his family and the earth.

At this moment, a loud voice sounded in every corner of the earth.

“Planet Lord, I’m Tang Zeyuan of the Dragon Tiger Sect. I am here to spar with you!”

…

This voice immediately caused many people on Earth to start discussing.

“A few years ago, someone seemed to have shouted for the Planet Master.”

“That’s right! It was also someone from the Dragon Tiger Sect, but he seemed to be called Qin something.”

“Who’s the Planet Lord?”

“Does our Earth really have a lord? Is it the Jade Emperor?”

“It must be Buddha. A few years ago, Guanyin appeared.”

“Did they spar last time? Who won?”

…

When Lin Fan heard the voice, he looked up into the sky.

[Tang Zeyuan: Level-one Universe cultivator. He’s a core disciple of the Dragon Tiger Sect and a genius. Because Qin Qiuliang was boasting about your strength, he developed an interest in you. He specially came to challenge you. Current favorability: Two stars.]

Lin Fan’s lips twitched. “That fellow…”

Then, he used the Heavenly Eye to observe carefully.

Very soon, Lin Fan shook his head.

Was this also a genius?

Why was his entire body filled with weaknesses?

Geniuses in novels were not like this.

Lin Fan first said to Hu Tian and the others, “I’ll be back soon.”

Then, he took a step forward and instantly appeared in the void.

When Tang Zeyuan saw Lin Fan, his eyes that seemed to be filled with stars lit up. He said, “Are you the lord of this planet? May I ask what this planet is called?”

“Earth,” Lin Fan said.

After all, Tang Zeyuan had a good impression of him.

In addition, there was no problem with just saying his name.

“Earth?” Tang Zeyuan asked. “How domineering!”

Then, he cupped his fists and said seriously, “I’m Tang Zeyuan of the Dragon Tiger Sect.”

“I’m Lin Fan form Earth.”

As soon as he finished speaking, a gust of wind suddenly whistled between the two of them, blowing their clothes and hair gently.

In the next moment…

Tang Zeyuan took a step forward and charged toward Lin Fan.

Lin Fan casually slapped out.

The overwhelming energy instantly turned into billions of sword energies.

All the sword energy quickly gathered and turned into a huge sword that was comparable to the sun.

The long sword flew out, sweeping with endless terrifying pressure. It suddenly crushed toward Tang Zeyuan.

“What?”

Tang Zeyuan’s pupils constricted, and a sense of despair that he had never felt before appeared in his heart.

“I’m finished!”

Just as Tang Zeyuan thought he was about to die, the energy sword suddenly stopped a few centimeters away from him.

Even so, the terrifying wind still blew his clothes and hair straight.

Tang Zeyuan panted heavily, as if his strength had been instantly sucked dry. His entire body went limp.

With a wave of his hand, the energy sword dissipated instantly.

“Let’s end the spar here.”

After saying that, Lin Fan took a step out and disappeared into the void.

“I’ll become stronger and challenge you again!” Tang Zeyuan gritted his teeth and said.

His voice was like a great flood, rippling across the earth.

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Tang Zeyuan’s favorability toward you has increased to four stars.]

When Lin Fan heard this, a strange look appeared on his face.

Could it be that all so-called geniuses liked to be abused?

Lin Fan shook his head and tossed this matter to the back of his mind.

Then, he turned his attention to the system interface.

[Host: Lin Fan]

[Cultivation: Level-three Universe]

[Skills: Sword 81 (Emeperor), Curse (Emperor), Sword Nurturing Technique (Emperor), Cosmos Sword Technique (Emperor)…]

[Equipment: Star Meteorite Sword (Emperor), Flame Armor (Emperor), Heavenly Soul Pearl (Emperor), True Dragon Sword (Emperor)…]

[Laws: Time (intermediate), Space (intermediate), Metal (intermediate), Wood (intermediate), Water (intermediate), Fire (intermediate), Earth (intermediate), Life (intermediate), Death (intermediate), Yin (intermediate), Yang (intermediate), Wind (intermediate)]

[Character Relationship:]

[Lin Tao: Dad; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Dai Weixue: Mom; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Lin Xiaoyao: Sister; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Xue: Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

[Xia Bing, Dao companion; Favorability: Ten stars]

When he looked at the character relationships, Lin Fan suddenly realized that the favorability of Star Lord Qing Song and Star Lord Feng Yue had dimmed down.

As for Ma Zheng, who had a strong impression of him, his profile picture was flickering.

Lin Fan could not help but feel puzzled.

Lin Fan had a pretty good impression of these three.

After pondering for a moment, he chose to communicate with Ma Zheng.

…

Ma Zheng was fleeing in all directions, his face filled with panic.

A loud voice suddenly sounded in his mind.

“Ma Zheng, what happened to you?”

Ma Zheng was stunned at first, then he hurriedly asked, “Senior Lin?”

“It’s me,” Lin Fan said.

Ma Zheng looked around, but he did not see Lin Fan.

Lin Fan seemed to have thought of this as well and explained, “I’m not near you. I’m just using a special method to communicate with you.”

Ma Zheng revealed a look of realization.

Then, he briefly explained what had happened recently.

It turned out that the universe competition was about to begin, and all living beings in the universe began to crazily increase their strength in order to obtain outstanding performance in the competition.

The Bug Queen, who had once spent a lot of effort to station itself on Qing Planet, could have used this opportunity to greatly increase her cultivation, but she was destroyed.

The Bug Queen felt that she had missed the opportunity of the universe competition.

Hence, the Bug Queen came to the Spring Region in anger and killed Star Lord Qing Song and Star Lord Feng Yue.

If Ma Zheng had not coincidentally gone to visit a friend, he would have also been killed.

Even so, Ma Zheng still suffered a terrifying attack.

“Senior Lin, you have to be careful,” Ma Zheng said. “This Bug Queen has an extraordinary background. She’s the daughter of an ancient mighty figure. Even the Spring Region’s Protectorate Lord doesn’t dare to offend her too much.”
